summary: A row of buttons and controls, like the main navigation bar with back/forward/reload.
description:
The real XUL <toolbar> element.

**Not Lit and not a registered custom element:** <toolbar> is a built-in XUL tag with no dedicated JS class, which is why navigator-toolbox.js delegates events on the outer #navigator-toolbox container rather than on any individual toolbar.

**Its configuration is still real and citable:** navigator-toolbox.inc.xhtml declares five of them (toolbar-menubar, TabsToolbar, nav-bar, PersonalToolbar, notifications-toolbar) carrying attributes CustomizableUI reads to decide whether an area is customizable, where widgets actually land, and how overflow behaves.

attributes.name: customizable
attributes.description: Presence-only. CustomizableUI checks hasAttribute("customizable") to decide whether this toolbar is a customizable area at all.

attributes.name: customizationtarget
attributes.description: Id of the element that actually receives widgets. CustomizableUI falls back to the toolbar node itself when the attribute is absent.

attributes.name: overflowable
attributes.description: Marks the area as overflowable, gating CustomizableUI's overflow handling. Immutable once the area is registered.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Area type read by CustomizableUI, and immutable once registered. "menubar" on toolbar-menubar.

attributes.name: context
attributes.description: Id of the context menu to open on right-click; read by CustomizableUI. "toolbar-context-menu" on nav-bar.
